threads.body: [Config] This breaking-change entry omits the removal of the stable `jedis-2.0-core` and `jedis-2.3-cluster` enablement selectors performed by the constructor changes. Users relying on either selector will otherwise see their setting silently stop applying without migration guidance in the release notes; include the replacement selector here.

 ### ⚠️ Breaking changes
 
+- The Java agent no longer instruments Jedis 1.x. Upgrade to Jedis 2.0 or later to continue receiving
+  automatic Redis database client spans and metrics.
